tei:div.tei:p: )rigs gsum 'phags pa'i sgyu 'phrul seng chen rje'i// don brgyud dgongs pa'i gter mdzod rang dbang bsgyur// 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// nam mkha' dri med rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs// khyod zhabs bskal pa rgya mtshor rab brtan cing*// rlabs chen phrin las phyogs mthar yongs brdal bas// snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i rgud mun drung phyungs te// phan bde'i dge mtshan snang bas rtag khyab shog /

ces pa'ang sngags ston rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes so// ༈ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong nas thugs rje'i gar// zab don sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul// dri med dam pa'i yon tan rab 'byams mnga'// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces pa'ang sngags btsun rdo rje rnam rgyal nas lha reg bcas bskul ngor// maṅga las bris pa dge legs 'phel/// / 1$0000024
